activities.name: Surf Lesson at Kuta Beach
activities.description: Kuta's beach break is the easiest learning wave in Bali — consistent knee-to-waist-high shore-break, professional ISA-certified instructors, foam boards included. Group lessons at 08:00 and 14:00.

activities.name: Full Day at Waterbom Bali
activities.description: Asia's top-rated water park for multiple consecutive years: 37 slides including the Climax (vertical free-fall), Superbowl (360° loop), and Lazy River over 3.8 ha of manicured tropical gardens. All-inclusive wristband.

activities.name: Kuta Sunset Walk
activities.description: Stroll 4km of black volcanic sand from Kuta to Legian at sunset — Bali's most accessible ocean sunset, free, no reservation needed. Vendors sell corn on the cob and coconuts along the way.

activities.name: Kuta Nightlife: Legian Street
activities.description: The most concentrated strip of nightlife in Bali: Sky Garden (6 floors), Bounty (2,000 capacity replica ship), Apache (live reggae, no cover), Mango's (rooftop terrace). Best from 22:00 onwards.

activities.name: Traditional Balinese Spa
activities.description: One-hour Balinese massage with hot stone and lemongrass oil at one of Kuta's dozens of garden spas. Book walk-in on Popples Lane or Poppies Lane II — rates start at $10 USD.

activities.name: Krisna Souvenir Shopping
activities.description: Three floors of Balinese handicrafts, batik, silver jewellery, branded food products, and resort wear. Fixed prices (no bargaining needed), huge selection, and air-conditioned — the most efficient one-stop souvenir shop in Bali.
